subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the service technician in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>: a man around 35 with short dark-blond hair, light stubble, a dark navy work jacket with grey piping, dark work trousers and black work boots.
<Subject 2> is the small car-repair workshop in <Picture 3>, characterized by a scratched wooden workbench along the left wall with a paper service book, pens and an old mobile phone on it, a red tool trolley, two cars on lifts, a narrow parts shelf with cardboard boxes at the back, fluorescent tubes overhead with a cool cast, and a bright roller door at the far end.
<Audio 1> is the complete Czech narrator voiceover track and is reused 1:1 as the target video's spoken audio layer; it remains audible across every transition and no character on screen speaks.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reuse] A 10-second vertical documentary-style testimonial cut to <Audio 1>, which continues uninterrupted across every cut. <Subject 1> sits facing the camera at the workbench in <Subject 2> writing a job into a paper service book, is interrupted by the old mobile phone ringing, and starts hunting through the paperwork for an answer he does not have.

<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the workbench with the service book and phone, the red tool trolley, the cars on lifts, the parts shelf and the fluorescent light are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video is a calm, believable vertical 9:16 documentary-style testimonial shot on a phone, photorealistic, with flat cool fluorescent workshop light and no colour grade, no on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos.
[Shot 1] A medium shot of <Subject 1> from the front across the workbench in <Subject 2>, his face clearly visible, sitting leaning over the battered paper service book and writing a job line with a ballpoint pen, the old mobile phone lying dark beside the book, the red tool trolley and a car on a lift soft behind him. He writes, pauses, glances up past the camera toward the workshop and back down, and writes again. The camera holds a static shot with a slight handheld shake of small amplitude.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.700, the shot cuts to a close-up over the workbench from the side while the narration from <Audio 1> continues uninterrupted: the old mobile phone lights up and vibrates quietly against the wood beside the service book; <Subject 1>'s hand stops writing, hesitates, then picks the phone up and out of frame. The camera holds a static shot with a slight handheld shake of small amplitude.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.100, the shot cuts to a medium shot of <Subject 1> from the front while the narration from <Audio 1> continues uninterrupted, the phone at his ear, listening, his free hand lifting two sheets from the paperwork pile beside the book to look underneath, then a third, his brow tightening as he finds nothing; he glances toward the parts shelf at the back of <Subject 2>. The camera holds a static shot with a slight handheld shake of small amplitude.

overall_soundscape:
The copied narration from <Audio 1> leads throughout and is never interrupted. Underneath it, quiet workshop room tone, a pen scratching on paper, a phone vibrating softly on wood, paper sheets lifting and settling, a compressor cycling far off.
